messages:
Rae - Eng Manager: Quick scenario: Ethan finished a cross-org project, transferred last week, and asks for mid-cycle promotion consideration. Transfer date falls inside the promo window. Can we count the old-team work?
Olivia - People Ops: Short: yes, but we need a clear ownership statement and sign-offs from both managers. Also mark the packet as "mid-cycle transfer" so calibration chairs flag it.
Ethan - IC: Most of the work was with Rae's team; transfer paperwork shows new manager as of 2026-08-02. What do you need in the ownership statement?
Rae - Eng Manager: I'll draft it but would like a template to speed things up.
Olivia - People Ops: Use this minimal template (paste into the packet):
```
- Contributor: Ethan H.
- Project: cross-region KV sharding
- Dates: 2026-05-10 to 2026-08-01
- Contribution summary: designed sharding strategy, led rollout, authored ops runbook
- Impact: 30% reduction in tail latency for region B, ~$14k/month infra savings
- Ownership: Primary delivery by Rae's team through 2026-08-01; transitioned to Singh's team on 2026-08-02. Both managers confirm contribution and scope.
```
Sam - Payroll: Timing note: comp approvals must hit payroll system by 2026-08-10 23:59 UTC for change to reflect on next pay period. If approvals come later we'll process a retro the following pay run. Provide EID in the packet to avoid manual lookups.
Ethan - IC: If calibration approves after payroll window, will my base be backdated to transfer date?
Olivia - People Ops: We will attempt to backdate base salary to the requested effective date if approvals happened before comp cutoff; otherwise a retro payment is processed. Equity adjustments follow grant cycle and are not immediate.
Locale Bot: Reminder: International employees require Employment Ops review for taxes/visa. Flag the country in the packet.
Rae - Eng Manager: One more: the new org maps this role differently (IC4 vs IC3). Do we need a leveling exception?
Olivia - People Ops: Yes, cross-org mapping differences require a leveling-exception form. Include org mapping rationale and sample role benchmarks. Mark "escalate" if urgent and ping me. Calibration + Comp will review.
Ethan - IC: If the exception is denied, could I get a spot bonus instead?
Olivia - People Ops: Common fallback: spot bonus or off-cycle increase depending on durability of the change and budget. Spot bonuses don't change base. Anything >5% requires comp approval.
Sam - Payroll: Operational checklist for managers submitting spot or off-cycle: 1) manager rationale, 2) evidence links, 3) suggested amount, 4) budget owner code, 5) EID. Deadlines apply: comp sign-off by 2026-08-08 23:59 UTC, payroll file by 2026-08-10 18:00 PT.
Rae - Eng Manager: I'll prepare the evidence + both manager endorsements today and tag Olivia for a pre-check.
Olivia - People Ops: Thanks. I'll run a quick pre-check and confirm calibration timeline. If you expect international delays, CC employment-ops early. Thread closed pending packet submission. :white_check_mark:
